payload.summary: Owner sign-off: 109 drafted MHA Act-section summaries and 9 drafted timeline deadlines, after the 54 form guides
payload.detail: Tool: npm run clinical:review -- --write --walk --kind section / --kind timeframe (guide docs/clinical-sign-off-how-to.md; sign on a dated clinical-signoff-<date> branch cut from main, main is protected). After signing any timeframe: npm run offline:build, bump CACHE_VERSION in public/sw.js, update the offline.html hash pin in tests/pwa-manifest.test.ts. Only the owner may sign.
